name: devshift
description: Switch approved Windows development workloads between Development and Gaming modes.
author: DevShift contributors

scripts.build:native: dotnet publish native/DevShift.Windows.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained -o dist/native
scripts.build:desktop: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && vite build
scripts.build: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:native
scripts.build:service-fixture: dotnet publish tests/service-fixture/pg_ctl.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained -o artifacts/service-fixture
scripts.test:windows:service: npm run build && npm run build:service-fixture && node --test tests/windows-service.test.mjs
